Archive packages in CRAN-like repositories2

archive_package.Rd

Archive packages in CRAN-like repositories2

Usage

archive_package(
  package_name,
  codename = NULL,
  local_build_root = ".",
  endpoint = "https://s3.eu-central-003.backblazeb2.com",
  region = "eu-central-003",
  bucket = "devxy-arm64-r-binaries",
  arch = NULL,
  debug = FALSE
)

Arguments

package_name

(character)
Package name

codename

(character)
Linux distribution identifier

local_build_root

(character)
Path to local build root

endpoint

(character)
S3 endpoint

region

(character)
S3 region

bucket

(character)
S3 bucket name

arch

(character)
Architecture

debug

(Date)
Date or date interval

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
archive_package("AATtools", codename = "rhel9")
archive_package("adw", codename = "rhel8", arch = "amd64")
} # }
